title: haven: identifierQuery answers a bare 200 or 404, never an IdentifierResponse (DIV-4, confirmed live)
description: Confirmed live (B4 steps 7a/7b), Haven 07ce96f; documented in Haven DIVERGENCES.md DIV-4 (L39-54). protocol-07 §5.8 L2591-2592: 'The response body is described as an IdentifierResponse'; L2596-2597: notFound is a responseCode inside it. mimi-hubd identifier_query_wire (mimi-hubd/src/http.rs L516) returns a bare 200 (handle enrolled) or 404 (not found, or unanswerable), no body either way. mimid PeerClient::identifier_query gets an empty 200 body (IdentifierResponse decode: EndOfStream) or Rejected{404}. Wrong reading: Haven, deliberately (anti-enumeration), and documented, so nothing to report unless Mark wants to point out that a draft-conformant client cannot read either answer (DIV-4 could say so). No mimid change.
close_reason: Fixed on Haven's side: live run 2026-11-15 09:27Z against ea645b1 got an IdentifierResponse for every query (Success with the user URI, and NotFound with HTTP 200). Vectors jt-iq-04/06 updated.
